parameters.content:
## 1. Find the contact
Direct GET by email (consistent right away), then search by phone. A source id already on the contact means a repeat submission: stop here.

## 2. Classify
OpenAI (or a stored mock answer) sorts the lead. Code checks the enums and that the quote is really in the message. Any failure becomes **Needs review** with no draft and a Slack alert.

## 3. Write to HubSpot
Update or create the contact (a 409 means it already exists, so update it), then add a note with the original message and the AI reason.

## 4. Human review
Draft a reply, post the review link to Slack and wait. Nothing is sent until a named reviewer approves; the decision is saved as a note.
